## Boundary decision (recorded in ADR-0277)
The §5h.2 ops land as **records-in/records-out** Group L ops
(`lab.eval.*`) — pure functions over lab records; the §06 store-backed
analysis surface (`lab.analysis.*`, `lab.results.*`) remains S3.4a–c's
(the CLI `compare report|scorecard` verbs already target those staged
ops). The `benchmark_adapter` ops run out of process
(`hh-bench-adapter`, newline-JSON over stdio — the `hh-mcp-serve`
precedent), matching `ClassRecord.locality = out_of_process`.

- `hh-bench` — 13 acceptance tests: typed reward + bad-shape refusals,

- `hh-embed` conformance — 43: `lab.eval.*` records-in/records-out,

- `hh-cli` in_process — 62: `hh eval` verbs, Group L routing.
